create_LabelPropagation_model: create a semi-supervised label propagation classifier with RBF kernel for label assignment on unlabeled data
create_LabelSpreading_model: create a semi-supervised label spreading classifier with soft clamping for robust label assignment
build_graph_matrix: build an affinity or graph laplacian matrix for label propagation using RBF or KNN kernel
run_predict_labels: run label propagation model to predict class labels for new unlabeled samples
run_predict_proba: run label propagation model to predict probability estimates for each class outcome
